desc:
Game horor co-op sudut pandang orang pertama. Malam ini kamu datang ke rumah studio seorang streamer, tapi lampunya mati dan pintunya terkunci. Pakai senter HP, cari jalan keluar bersama teman, dan jangan sampai sosok bermata merah itu menangkapmu. Ada 3 ending yang bisa kamu temukan.

A first-person co-op horror game. Tonight, you arrive at a streamer’s studio, but the lights are out and the doors are locked. Use your phone’s flashlight to find a way out with your friends—and don’t let the red-eyed figure catch you. There are 3 different endings for you to discover.
